claims.scope: Every relative-1/16 robust trigger edge in a genuine centered minimum-dimensional rho>4 F/J critical core.
claims.statement: If q_rho is defined by h2(q_rho)/q_rho=rho and c_rho=D_2(Ber(7/16)||Ber(q_rho)), then every robust trigger edge (i,k) obeys I(X_i;X_k)>=c_rho q_i. Uniformly for rho>4, I(X_i;X_k)>c_4 q_i with c_4=0.32031813133655726... .

claims.scope: Finite directed trigger graphs with robust outdegree at least d_rho.
claims.statement: There is an acyclic directed trigger subgraph whose underlying graph is a forest, with one selected outgoing trigger for robust vertices carrying at least d_rho/(d_rho+1) of any prescribed nonnegative robust-vertex weight.

claims.scope: Genuine centered minimum-dimensional rho>4 F/J critical cores.
claims.statement: For R the relative-1/16 robust rows, sum_{i in R} q_i <= ((d_rho+1)/(d_rho c_rho)) TC(X). Uniformly over rho>4, sum_R q_i < 4.162528445610855 TC(X), equivalently TC(X)>0.24023859850241795 sum_R q_i.

claims.scope: Critical cores satisfying the explicit low-total-correlation side condition.
claims.statement: No rho>4 critical core can satisfy TC(X)<=0.24023859850241795 sum_{i in R}q_i. In particular an all-robust core with TC(X)<=0.24023859850241795 J is impossible.
The robust mass Q_R obeys simultaneously Q_R<=((d_rho+1)/(d_rho c_rho))TC(X) and Q_R<=2(P-DTC)/33+H4/33. If all active rows are robust then TC(X)>0.2402385985 J and H4>(33-4/ln2)J=27.2292198364...J.

claims.scope: Proposed universal auxiliary implication TC(X)<=C J for all Boolean spectral laws with one dimension-independent C.
claims.statement: Recursive ternary majority has q_i=2^{-m}, J=(3/2)^m, H=4(J-1), and TC/J=h2(2^{-m})/2^{-m}-4+4/(3/2)^m -> infinity. Hence generic TC=O(J) is false. This does not refute FEI.
